meta.title: Tarteeba · Home cleaning in the UAE
meta.description: Trained cleaners at a time that suits you. Single visits, recurring plans and full-day service.

hero.title: A tidy home, a calm mind
hero.body: Trained cleaners who arrive at a time that suits you. Choose the service and slot in the app, and we confirm availability before the visit.
hero.point2: We drive them to you and back

services.title: Services for your home
services.body: Start with one visit, make it a weekly routine, or get a cleaner for the whole day.

visit.title: Cleaning visit
visit.body: General cleaning and tidying of rooms, kitchen and bathrooms. Choose how many cleaners suit your home.
visit.point1: One or more cleaners in the same visit

recurring.title: Recurring plan
recurring.body: Regular weekly visits with a package discount and priority for your preferred cleaner.
recurring.point1: Choose visits per week and the days
recurring.point2: Pause while you travel or skip a visit
recurring.point3: Auto-renewal you can turn off any time

liveOut.title: Full day
liveOut.body: A fixed main cleaner for a full working day with a rest hour, as a trial day or a monthly plan.
liveOut.point2: A trained substitute if she's absent

services.excluded: Deep cleaning and sofa or carpet cleaning are not offered yet.

how.title: How Tarteeba works
how.step1Body: Set the number of cleaners, your address and what matters most.
how.step2Body: You only see days and slots that are actually available in your area.
how.step3Body: We place a hold on your card without charging it, and your request is pending confirmation.
how.step4Body: Our team confirms availability, then the charge goes through and you track the arrival in the app.
how.note: A booking is final only after our bookings team confirms it. If the slot can't be served, we suggest alternatives or release the hold.

why.title: Why Tarteeba
why.punctualBody: We plan vehicle routes before every slot and notify you when the car leaves and the cleaner arrives.
why.preferredBody: We prioritise your preferred cleaner, and may send a trained substitute when she's not available.
why.trainedBody: Cleaners employed by Tarteeba, with valid documents and a quality check after every visit.
why.clearBody: You see VAT, fees and the expected refund before you confirm anything.
why.secureBody: Card, Apple Pay or Google Pay through the payment gateway. We never store your card details.
why.careBody: Rate every visit, and open a complaint linked to the booking that we follow through to resolution.

areas.title: Where we work
areas.body: We're starting in selected areas of Dubai and expanding step by step. Add your address in the app to see right away whether it's covered.
areas.cta: Check your address in the app

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: After you send a request it's pending confirmation. Our bookings team checks cleaner and vehicle availability, then confirms, and you get a notification either way.
faq.a2: When you send the request we only place a hold on your card. You're charged when we confirm; if we don't, the hold is released.
faq.q3: Will I get the same cleaner every time?
faq.a3: We prioritise your preferred cleaner but can't guarantee she's available for every visit. If she's away we send a trained substitute and let you know in advance.
faq.q4: Do I need to provide cleaning materials?
faq.a4: You choose during booking. If the company provides them, the fee shows in the price summary before you pay.
faq.q5: How do I cancel or reschedule?
faq.a5: From the booking details in the app. We show the fee and expected refund under the policy before you confirm.
faq.a6: We first check the result with the payment gateway before showing any message. Then you can retry or change the method without being charged twice.

app.title: Book in the Tarteeba app
app.body: Booking, payment, arrival tracking and invoices, all in the app, in Arabic and English.

footer.vat: All prices are in UAE dirhams and include VAT.
